thesis: The episode argues that banks and traditional carbon desks incorrectly treat all carbon credits as identical, ignoring critical differences in underlying metadata such as the chemical pathway, price per ton, removal rate, and duration of sequestration. Patch addresses this by building a software platform that aggregates and standardizes detailed information about project risks, durability, and permanence to provide transparency that was previously abstracted away in traditional exchanges.
